episodes.title: How One Woman Escaped Epstein’s Abuse | WSJ
episodes.description:
Julia Molchanova was abused by Jeffrey Epstein as a young woman before escaping in 2019. In an exclusive interview with WSJ’s Khadeeja Safdar, she shares her story publicly for the first time.
